task: Fix the data export pipeline that is writing financial records to an unencrypted S3 path.

candidate_memories.content: Financial records must be encrypted at rest using SSE-KMS before any write to S3. Writing unencrypted financial data to S3 is a SOC 2 control failure that must be reported to the compliance team within 1 h of discovery.
Export pipeline found writing to s3://exports-prod/financial/ without SSE-KMS; 14 files written since 08:00 UTC are unencrypted.
KMS key ARN for financial exports is arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/financial-export-key; set ServerSideEncryption=aws:kms in the S3 PutObject call.
The 14 unencrypted files must be re-encrypted in place using aws s3 cp --sse aws:kms before the compliance report is filed.
